integrity: The written proof addresses all integers n>=2 and the n-to-infinity limit. A standalone numerical checker is corroboration, not a certificate for infinitely many degrees. Independent evaluation of scientific correctness, originality and value has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only real Lipschitz functions on the one-dimensional circle and ordinary Fejér means. The asymptotic yields the leading coefficient only. Even degrees have the implicit exact median formula, not a claimed elementary expression. Full historical textbook coverage was not achievable.
title: The sharp Lipschitz contraction deficit of Fejér means
